people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Red_Sea
people.line: Sea crossed by Israelites in the Exodus

translations.web: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
translations.bsb: He led them out and performed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, at the Red Sea, and for forty years in the wilderness.
translations.kjv: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
translations.asv: This man led them forth, having wrought wonders and signs in Egypt, and in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
